text: Long catch up with Nina. She's finally moving to Leeds, sometime in early March 2027, once the sale goes through. Wei is staying in London for now and is not thrilled about it. Remind me to ask Nina for the new address before she goes.
Julien's housewarming is Saturday 14 November 2026. He and Georgia got the flat in Bristol in the end, top floor, no lift. Said bring nothing but I'll take wine anyway.
Coffee with Joy. Her brother Florin is getting married over the summer, date not fixed yet. She's dreading the speech because she's maid of honour. Wants to get through it without crying.
Sean called. Dinner at his on the 2nd is off, Aditi has covid. He'll rearrange sometime after Christmas.

Owen viewed three flats in Glasgow this weekend and hated all of them. He's got another round sometime next week. Seems pretty low about the whole thing, been sleeping on his sister's sofa since August. Should check in with him Friday.
Need to book the van for my move, end of the month. Also cancel the broadband.

Rafael and Mei are throwing a joint 40th, sometime in the spring, probably April 2027. Big garden thing at Mei's parents' place. They asked if I'd DJ for an hour. Don't forget to send Rafael my playlist ideas.
Ximena is vegan now, properly, not just weekdays. Worth knowing for the dinner.

Ran into Astrid at the station. She's left Novak & Partners and starts somewhere new in January 2027. Her partner Giulia is expecting, due early May. They're looking for somewhere bigger before the baby comes, maybe out towards Surrey. Astrid's mum is moving in with them for a few months after the birth, which Astrid is very relaxed about and Giulia less so. Must send Giulia something small.
Malik's leaving drinks were last Thursday. Didn't make it. Text him to see how the first week at the new place went.
Imogen hates surprise parties, she was very clear. So no surprise thing for her 30th on 9 December 2026, just dinner somewhere nice. Aoife's organising.

Lunch with James. His dad had a fall a couple of weeks ago and is in hospital in Cork, so James is flying over sometime next week. He's okay but tired. Luca is covering for him at work. Ring James when he's back.
Sinead got the flat! The one on Elm Road. Moving in 1 December 2026, keys the day before. Her cat Biscuit is going to be furious about the stairs.
Jaya's engagement party, sometime in late January. Divya says they're thinking a curry house in Tooting. Will keep the weekends free.

Khadija's moving back to Manchester in the new year to be closer to her parents. Her mum's not been well. She asked if I could help pack on the weekend of the 28th, I said yes. Remind me to ask her about her mum's scan results.
Chloe and Ioana had people round on Friday. Lovely evening. Ioana is doing a pottery course now, Tuesdays, and is obsessed. Chloe's still at the council, still hates it.
Catalina mentioned she's been eyeing up a proper cast iron casserole dish for ages. Le Creuset, the orange one. Good shout for her birthday in March.
Dimitri says the Christmas party's not happening this year, budget cuts. He's doing drinks at his instead on 19 December 2026. Mehmet and Kate are going. I'm in.
Kate is nervous about the flat viewing tomorrow, it's her first time buying on her own and the estate agent is pushy. Text her good luck in the morning.
Sorted the gas meter reading. Still need to find a new dentist near the new place soonish.
Wei Nakamura from Nina's work invited me to his birthday drinks, end of next week. Nice of him, barely know him. Probably go for one.

Aditi and Sean are definitely moving to Edinburgh, sometime in the summer of 2027. Sean has a transfer lined up and Aditi will work remotely. They've got two kids so it's schools first, then a house. Their eldest, Rohan, is not happy about leaving his friends. I should ask Aditi how the school visits go next month.
Housewarming at Owen's new place, finally! Saturday 21 November. Bring a plant, he says he has none and the flat looks like a dentist's waiting room.
Call with Georgia. Grandad Joe passed away last Tuesday, funeral is sometime next week in Swansea. She's holding up but sounded exhausted. Julien's driving her down. Send flowers to her mum.
Florin's band is playing at the Lexington on 7 November 2026. He was very nervous about it, first gig with the new drummer. Andre and I are going.
Note to self: Giulia's surname is Dubois, not Dupont. Embarrassing.
Luca and his wife Mei are expecting twins, sometime in the spring. Found out after the 12 week scan last week. He's beaming, she's mostly sick all the time. Need to get them a card.
Talked to Andre after five a side. His flat viewing in Hackney on Wednesday went well, he's put in an offer. Fingers crossed. He's also getting a dog once he's settled, a rescue greyhound apparently.

Malik and Imogen split up. Their wedding was meant to be in June 2027, now it's off. Malik's moving out at the end of the month and staying with his brother Hassan for a bit. He's gutted. Must check in with him at the weekend.
Aoife's starting a masters in Dublin in September 2027. She's moving back home for it, renting her Leeds place out. Very excited.

Dinner with Jaya and her sister Divya. Divya just got into med school, starts after the summer. Jaya's planning a celebration dinner, maybe mid December. Remind me to congratulate Divya properly, I sort of fumbled it tonight.
Quiet one tonight, nothing much. Watched the match.
Mehmet's mum is turning 70 in the new year, January or February. Big family party in Izmir. He's going out for two weeks. He said the cousins are all coming from Germany.
Ioana's interview for the Lisbon job went well apparently, final round is early next month. If she gets it she's moving there in spring 2027. Ask her how the final went.
James Walsh is hosting a games night sometime before Christmas. He said he'll WhatsApp a date. Bringing Catan.

Catch up with Sinead and Khadija at the pub. Sinead's settling in at the new flat, though Biscuit has already broken a lamp. Khadija's mum has her results back and it's nothing serious, huge relief. Khadija is still moving in January but less of a rush now. We're doing a goodbye dinner for her sometime mid December, I'm meant to book somewhere. Don't forget to book the Thai place for 8.
Chloe has her driving test on 3 December 2026, third attempt. She's really anxious this time. Wish her luck the night before.
Dimitri's in Athens until the end of November, visiting his grandmother. Back for Mehmet's thing.
Viewing for the Clapham flat Thursday at 6. Bring payslips. Ask about the damp.

Astrid sent pics of the new house. They did go with Surrey in the end, moving 15 January 2027. She wants us all down for a housewarming once the baby's arrived, so probably summer. She sounds tired but happy.
Joy's birthday is 29 October. She's been hinting about wanting a record player. Chip in with Florin and Nina?
Kate got the flat she viewed! Exchanged yesterday, completion sometime in December. Send congrats tomorrow.

Georgia's back from Swansea. Doing a bit better, she said. Her mum is selling the family house in the spring and Georgia is helping clear it out. Probably a hard few months. I should take her for a drink next week.
Rafael Adeyemi from the climbing group invited everyone to his 30th on Saturday 5 December 2026. Fancy dress, theme is nineties. Dr Banerjee is apparently coming as a Spice Girl.
Wei said the office move to Canary Wharf got pushed back to March 2027. He'll have an awful commute from Walthamstow. Doesn't drink coffee, only green tea, remember for when he comes over.
Uncle Dimitri is coming over from Thessaloniki sometime after Christmas, staying with Mum for a fortnight. Need to sort the spare room before then.

Nina's leaving do, Friday 26 February 2027, before the Leeds move. Wei is organising and swears it won't be karaoke. Her mum and her brother Sean will come down from Manchester for it. Remind me to ask Wei about chipping in for a present.
Imogen is doing okay, she says. Throwing herself into work and marathon training, London in April 2027. Aoife thinks she's overdoing it. She's coming to dinner on the 4th.
Julien and Georgia's dinner party was so much fun. Julien made his famous tagine. Georgia's started at the architecture firm and loves it. Text Julien to say thanks.

Owen's sister Kate Kowalski is getting married in Kraków, sometime in August 2027. Owen is best man and has no idea what to say. He wants help with the speech closer to the time. Their mum is apparently already planning outfits. Should start jotting down funny Owen stories over the summer.
